'''Sotak'vik''' was a clan-[[City/Legends|city]] on [[Doneer'so]]. It was home to the [[Doneer]] [[Sotak city-clan]], and it was selected by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as the location of its [[Sector/Legends|sector]] governmental headquarters for the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]].<ref name="CP" />
